title: A Higher Calling
领受圣职
description: Become a priest of the temple.

title: Raise Your Voice
放声高歌
description: Earn permission to lead the temple choir.
获得神殿唱诗班的领唱许可。

title: An Uninvited Guest
不速之客
description: Bring the captives out of the cult's hideout, dismantle its ritual, and give Jordan an honest account.
救出林中巢穴的受困者，破坏仪式布置，并向约旦如实汇报。

title: Seeing It Through
有始有终
description: Resolve all four temple investigations and give Jordan an honest account.
完成神殿的四项调查，并向约旦如实汇报。

title: The Bells Ring for You
钟声为你们而鸣
description: Help both Robin and Sydney become priests of the temple.
帮助罗宾与悉尼各自成为神殿的司祭。

title: As Two, As One
两者如一
description: Complete the rite with Robin and Sydney and share the Confounded Vow.
与罗宾、悉尼完成仪式，共享混乱誓约。

title: Back Where It Belongs
物归原主
description: Return the ivory necklace, dream of its owner, and meet again at the shore.
归还象牙项链，梦见它的主人，并在湖岸再次相遇。

title: Lost Lamb
迷途羔羊
description: Follow Kylar’s childhood through the night that changed the manor, and find your way back.
经历凯拉尔与悉尼来往的旧日生活，以及庄园改变的那一夜，并回到现在。
